name: Dusk Knight converts Agility into parry rating and Intellect into dodge rating (#738)
contract: Dusk Knight 681200 (installed Spell.dbc) is a passive family-21 spell with two SPELL_AURA_MOD_RATING_FROM_STAT (220) effects: effect 0 misc 8 (bit 3 = CR_PARRY) MiscValueB 1 (Agility) base 39 die 1 -> 40, effect 1 misc 4 (bit 2 = CR_DODGE) MiscValueB 3 (Intellect) base 24 die 1 -> 25; the text reads 'parry rating by 40% of your Agility and your dodge rating by 25% of your Intellect'. Player::UpdateRating adds int32(CalculatePct(GetStat(MiscValueB), amount)) for every rating in the mask and UpdateStats refreshes it when the source stat moves. Base Agility and Intellect of a level-60 Witch Hunter are not values this scenario may assume, so the conversion is measured as a slope: after learning, a fixture aura with a known flat stat gain is applied and the rating must rise by that gain times the percentage. Increased Agility 40 (14404, MOD_STAT misc 1, base 39 die 1 = +40) must add 16 parry rating (15-17 absorbs the two int truncations); Increased Intellect 39 (14429, misc 3, +39) must add 9.75, so 9 or 10 dodge rating. The aura amounts are asserted first so a wrong fixture is caught.

steps.label: Let spawn AI and level scaling settle
Effect 0 is 40% of Agility as parry rating
Effect 1 is 25% of Intellect as dodge rating
+40 Agility adds 40% of it (16) as parry rating
+39 Intellect adds 25% of it (9.75 -> 9 or 10) as dodge rating
